# `lakana bundle`

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana bundle [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Generate a team deployment bundle.

## `lakana bundle init`

Usage: `lakana bundle init [OPTIONS] [directory]`

Generate compose.yaml and .env for a team deployment, and save a profile.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DIRECTORY` | path | `lakana-deploy` | Target directory for the bundle. |
| `--public-url` | text | none | The URL clients and the saved profile use. |
| `--bind` | text | `127.0.0.1` | Host address the server port is published on. |
| `--port` | whole number | `8000` | Host port for the server. |
| `--workers` | whole number | `2` | Worker replicas. |
| `--image` | text | none | Override the Lakana image reference. |
| `--task-image` | text | none | Override the task images' reference (without -py3.X). |
| `--ui` | flag | off | Turn the web interface on; --public-url must then be an https DNS name. |
